name: IIT Delhi Institute Post-Doctoral Fellowship (IPDF)
amount: Rs 80,000/month (Rs 65,000 until thesis defence) + HRA + Rs 1 lakh/year professional development allowance
other_rules: Indian nationals, or foreign candidates with a PhD from outside India
maximum age 32 for men and 35 for women (relaxation for reserved categories)
not aimed at IIT Delhi PhD holders
notes: Example of IIT institute postdocs (IIT Bombay, BHU, Dhanbad and others run similar schemes). 2026 call closed 15 Apr 2026. 1 year, extendable by 1 after review. No institute housing.
